From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Price <lauren.price@auroratech.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: COI and endorsements for Redwood PO prep

Thanks Lauren — got the packet and the roster. Quick notes after a first pass: 

1) Additional insured: the GL endorsement looks fine for general liability, but Redwood requires Additional Insured wording to include both "ongoing operations" and "completed operations" for the PO scope. The endorsement you sent appears to be limited — can you confirm whether Ongoing + Completed are explicitly included? If not, please request the carrier to amend.

2) Cyber coverage: since AuroraTech is touching customer data for integration, we need an endorsement or affirmation that the cyber policy extends to vendors and includes incident response costs. If the carrier needs 3–5 business days, that will be fine, but flagging this as a gating item for the final PO issuance.

3) Waiver of subrogation: absent a waiver we will still be able to issue a conditional PO, but final payment may be contingent on waiver language for services involving on-prem deployments.

4) Subcontractor list: thank you — Neha, can you review the roster for any flagged subcontractors without cyber coverage? Jonas: I see two entries flagged in the sheet (lines 4 and 9).

Next steps:
- Lauren: please confirm the completed/ongoing wording on the GL endorsement and whether the carrier can issue the cyber endorsement within 5 business days.
- Neha: if any subcontractor is missing required coverage, we'll propose a conditional PO clause for remedial steps.

We can issue a conditional PO (30-day activation window) that allows AuroraTech to start non-production integration work while they secure final endorsements.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: COI and endorsements for Redwood PO prep

Marissa / Neha — forwarding AuroraTech's update. Broker attestation satisfies the GL ongoing/completed requirement. Cyber endorsement expected by 17 Jun.

Proposed conditional PO terms for legal/procurement review and sign-off: 
- PO status: Conditional Activation (work may begin in non-prod environments).
- Activation window: 30 days from PO effective date to supply final cyber endorsement; if endorsement not provided, Redwood may (i) extend once by 14 days or (ii) suspend non-prod access and hold invoicing until evidence provided.
- Billing: invoices processed subject to final compliance verification; initial milestone invoice (up to 20%) payable on delivery of non-prod access; remainder subject to full evidence.
- Subcontractor remediation: AuroraTech to provide mitigation plan within 7 days for any subcontractor lacking cyber coverage; critical subcontractors (those with access to customer data) must have coverage or be replaced.

Neha, can you confirm which subcontractors are critical and whether the remediation sentence above is sufficient? Also please loop Legal if we need to tweak language for vendor replacements.

If all good, I'll draft the conditional PO and route for signatures.

Thanks,
Jonas
